verdicts.reason: A reads left to right with a sensible order (logo, product, headline and subcopy, CTA), but the can is tiny and loses its cream circle. The 'New Flavor' badge has shrunk to an illegible rotated pill under the can, and a stray circle fragment peeks out behind the CTA at the right edge. B is badly broken: the oversized headline runs into the CTA ('Sunset' touches the button), the badge collides with the end of the subcopy, the logo is shrunk to an unreadable speck at the bottom, and the subcopy is pushed down against the bottom edge.
